messages:
ash: Heads up — I'm seeing a regression in private/VPC small-GPU runs. First-token spikes on cold starts jumped from ~45ms to 220-400ms intermittently. Looks like KV prefill + kernel-selection thrash. :eyes:
maria: Can you paste the profiler snippet and the exact config used for that slice?
ash (typo in name corrected): sorry meant ash: here's a short trace from the runtime profiler (cold-start run):
```
[profiler] batch_id=0 seq_len=16 batch_size=1
kernel_select: selected fp16_attention (fast path)
kernel_fallback: switched to fp32_matmul (batch_size==1, smallgpu heuristic) -> +120ms
kv_prefill: 118ms (prefill 512 tokens)
queue_fill: waited 80ms for token_budget allocation
first_token_latency: 342ms
```
kevin: ugh. two things jump out: (1) prefill size is way too large for smallgpu/cold flows, (2) our kernel selector has aggressive fallback on batch_size==1 and then oscillates as kv prefetch changes timing.
sophia: agree. proposal: expose two per-deployment knobs for Private: `prefill_budget` (tokens to prefetch on cold request) and `queue_jitter_ms` (randomized delay to avoid N clients aligning). Default for hosted stays high; smallgpu-default = 128 tokens and jitter 5-20ms.
kevin: tentative config snippet for deployment override: 
```json
{"inference": {"batching": {"prefill_budget": 128, "queue_jitter_ms": 12, "token_budget_target": 512}, "kernel": {"hysteresis_ms": 50}}}
```
ash (ash): also adding `kernel.hysteresis_ms` to prevent immediate kernel_fallback when batch briefly dips to 1 — hold decision for 50ms and re-evaluate. This avoids thrash between fp16/fp32.
maria: can we get quick metrics to justify changes? I want to see p50/p95 first_token_latency, kv_prefill_time_ms, kv_hit_ratio, batch_fill_time_ms across canary vs baseline.
perf-bot: canary run started for tenant `acme-corp` with override profile `smallgpu-cold-1`. Metrics snapshot (1h): p50_first_token=52ms, p95_first_token=410ms, avg_kv_prefill=105ms, kv_hit_ratio=0.72, cpu_gpu_switches=14. Link: https://metrics.internal/runs/2009876543
kevin: thanks. plan: (A) open PR to wire the two knobs + kernel.hysteresis, (B) add unit/integration tests that simulate prefill delay and ensure hysteresis prevents immediate fallback, (C) run a 24h canary in private region eu-west-2.
sophia: add an e2e script that reproduces cold-launch with `--seeded-requests` so we don't rely on traffic bursts. Example: `./tools/e2e_run --deploy smallgpu --seed 1000 --prefill 512`.
ash (ash): assigning PR to @kevin. I'll prepare the canary config and alert rules: create alerts on p95_first_token > 200ms AND kv_prefill_time_ms > 60ms.
kevin: will open PR in ~1h, tagging @maria for review. Also will include a short migration note for customers who previously patched their own per-deployment overrides.
maria: small ask — add a debug endpoint that returns the active prefill budget and kernel_hysteresis value for a deployment (read-only) so support can triage without a full canary.
kevin: good call, adding `/internal/v1/deployments/{id}/runtime-config` to the PR.
perf-bot: canary job reported back: after applying prefill_budget=128 + kernel.hysteresis=50ms, p95_first_token dropped to 155ms over 2h sample. :party_parrot:
ash (ash): awesome. next steps: roll to 10% of smallgpu private clusters, monitor for regression, then 100%. I'll post the rollout timeline in #eng-releases.
sophia: also consider a follow-up to tune `token_budget_target` per model family — some long-context models benefit from higher token_budget but smallgpu customers don't.
kevin: noted. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4621 (will update live).
maria: thanks everyone — filing a short postmortem draft after rollout completes.
